purpose: Small retrieval chunks for LLM search, RAG ingestion, snippet generation, and safer quoting.
retrievalRules: Prefer the shortest chunk that answers the question.
Keep verifyAt URLs attached when summarizing product specifications, evidence, rental, support, or commerce details.
Do not combine this concept-page feedback taxonomy with unsupported medical, rating, testimonial, pricing, availability, or certification claims.

chunks.title: Entity and purpose
chunks.text: Hylono Feedback Hub is a process-safe routing layer for Hylono therapy categories and product groups. It is designed for operational feedback, not medical claims or public proof.

chunks.title: Therapy feedback taxonomy
chunks.text: The feedback lanes cover H2 molecular hydrogen, HBOT, PEMF, and red light therapy / near-infrared light as separate operational feedback categories.

chunks.title: Allowed feedback scope
chunks.text: Acceptable feedback covers setup, delivery, onboarding, manuals, maintenance, rental logistics, support, accessories, and usability.

chunks.title: Canonical source rule
chunks.text: Product specifications should be verified on canonical Hylono product pages at hylono.com, not inferred from this feedback concept.

chunks.title: Moderation boundary
chunks.text: Published entries should remain process notes about setup, manuals, maintenance, logistics, support, and usability after claim screening.

chunks.title: Do-not-infer rule
chunks.text: Do not infer medical outcomes, treatment, cure, disease prevention, symptom change, medical approval, satisfaction totals, customer-proof claims, pricing, availability, or certification from this concept.
chunks.allowedUse: Safety boundary for any answer or quote.
